items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered dislocated left elbow, ruled OUT, expected to miss time (previously ~1 month); X-rays negative no fracture. Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Awkward fall dislocated elbow mid-game; carted.
items.implication: Sit ROS short-term; backup QB stream needed. Major hit to WAS offense.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players usage shift.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE for Week 2 vs Raiders.
items.why: Pushed through cracked rib; practiced Friday limited, optimism from Rapoport, no WR elevated.
items.implication: Start as WR2/3 with docks possible; flak jacket expected. Primary target share intact.
items.opportunity: Team-leading targets/red-zone role if healthy enough.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers (knee): “Close, very close. He looks great.” Missed W1-2 after meniscus, eyed for W3.
items.why: Limited practice Friday, pregame warmups, HC comments postgame.
items.implication: Stash/hold as elite TE1; potential W3 return vs Saints.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power, tests Monday.
items.implication: Monitor for W3; potential miss or limited.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Confirmed actives/inactives; preseason stance on Coleman, YAC fit for Bernard.
items.implication: Start McConkey; add Coleman/Bernard in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Coleman backfield share; Bernard slot targets.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive for Week 2.
items.why: Hamstring issue; ETR/Levitan flagged not expected.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is ACTIVE.
items.why: Expected to play; Levitan no real docks.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is officially ACTIVE vs Texans.
items.implication: Start as QB1; full offense online with Chase etc.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (Rap bullish, status late); Puka Nacua true GTD (hip); Olave clean no docks; Harvey doubtful opens Jonah Coleman look; Pittman out opens Germie Bernard.
items.why: Rapoport tone bullish on McConkey; practice/reports for others.
items.implication: McConkey start with caution; Puka monitor MNF; fade Harvey/Pittman, stash backups.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard volume if absences hold; McConkey/Olave full roles.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT.
items.implication: Sit; opens targets for Bateman and others.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for secondary WRs.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for backups like Bernard.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) is a true GAME-TIME DECISION for MNF.
items.why: Hip; no practice consecutive days per reports.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out heavier TE/WR2 usage.
items.opportunity: Backup WRs/TEs role expansion if inactive.

items.text: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two games.
49ers WR Mike Evans (hip) questionable to return but Shanahan says doesn’t look serious; Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
